reviews.comment: He let me do my Friday quizzes on Wednesdays. Power points are useless just pray. His 314 class is harder than 310 with barrufet.

Competent lecturer, but the way his class is structured makes it highly difficult. Tests, including the final, are worth 85%. You have to really be familiar with the material to do well. Unfortunately, only example problems you have access to are lecture and HW problems. Solutions to these are often poorly written with many crucial steps missing.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bombards you with quizzes weekly. Lecture notes arent always easy to read and hell tend to skips some steps when working out problems. Weekly Homeworks are simple but they barely count for anything. You need to really understand the material to do well on exams. Barely gives partial credit on homeworks, quizzes, and exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader
